items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: I've had Monk borrow money from me and pay me back when I was too drunk to remember him even loaned it to him.

ctx.x: Ha! Monk inhaled. Monk used the excuse that he was an alcoholic because his father was an alcoholic and he inherited it from his father. Yet his father was supposed to have become an alcoholic after Monk was born. How could Monk have inherited that from his father? I'll never know. But excuses are excuses are excuses.
Maybe his father inherited it from Monk.
